findings.detail: Blocks 000193, 000198 and 000200: prior ticking cadence, heart/maw metaphor and handjob specificity have been corrected against source.
Block 000290: ankle-kissing and hand placement now read naturally without changing action.

Block 000203: 'единственное время, когда Илья вообще сидел спокойно, — когда лежал ...' still creates a sitting-versus-lying contradiction in Russian. Replace 'сидел спокойно' with 'оставался неподвижным' or 'не шевелился', preserving the sense that he was still in his mother's lap.
